title: CoachSI: Self-Improvement of Robot Policies with a Language Coach
title_zh: CoachSI：借助语言教练实现机器人策略自改进
abstract_en: Generalist robot policies execute atomic skills reliably but fail when the same skills are composed into long-horizon tasks. Self-improvement from the policy's own experience does not close this gap: experience collected by the policy alone stays within its own distribution and reproduces what it can already do. We show that what the policy lacks is not a skill but the next step. We present CoachSI, a self-improvement method in which a frozen, off-the-shelf vision-language model (VLM) coaches the policy in language: it watches the robot and names the next step in the format of the policy's atomic instructions, and never outputs an action. Successful coached rollouts are relabeled in hindsight with the original task instruction and used to fine-tune the policy. The fine-tuned policy is then deployed on its own. On states where a World Action Model and a Vision-Language-Action model have stalled, naming the next step raises subgoal completion by 4.6x over the unchanged task instruction, and the frozen VLM supplies it from the same camera images the policy sees. After fine-tuning, unassisted success on long-horizon tasks in unseen scenes rises from 47.4% to 59.3%, 9.8 points above fine-tuning on human demonstrations and 7.3 points above fine-tuning on self-collected successes at an equal data budget. With a coach that sees only camera images, it reaches 56.8%, above both baselines. The gain is obtained with the action backbone frozen: language coaching teaches the policy what should happen next, and the skills it already has do the rest.
abstract_zh: 通用机器人策略能可靠执行原子技能，却常在把这些技能串联成长程任务时卡住。仅依赖策略自行采集的经验进行微调，往往只会重复它已经会做的事。论文指出，策略缺的并非技能，而是对下一步该做什么的判断。CoachSI 使用冻结的现成视觉语言模型（Vision-Language Model, VLM）担任教练：它观察机器人，用策略熟悉的原子指令格式提示下一步，但不直接输出动作。成功的受指导轨迹随后用原始任务指令重新标注，用于微调策略；部署时不再需要教练。在 World Action Model 和 Vision-Language-Action 模型已经卡住的状态下，相比继续使用原任务指令，明确提示下一步使子目标完成率达到原来的 4.6 倍。微调后，策略在未见场景中独立执行长程任务的成功率从 47.4% 升至 59.3%；在相同数据预算下，分别比使用人类示范和策略自行采集的成功轨迹微调高 9.8 和 7.3 个百分点。仅使用摄像头图像的教练也能将成功率提升至 56.8%，超过上述两条基线。整个微调过程中，动作主干保持冻结。
key_points_zh: 长程任务的瓶颈在于选择下一步，而非执行单项技能；在模型已卡住的状态下，提示下一步使子目标完成率达到原来的 4.6 倍。
CoachSI 让冻结的 VLM 只给语言提示、不输出动作，再用原任务指令重新标注成功轨迹，使策略部署时无需教练。
在未见场景中，无辅助成功率由 47.4% 升至 59.3%；同等数据预算下，比人类示范和自行采集成功轨迹的微调基线分别高 9.8 和 7.3 个百分点。
微调无需更新动作主干；教练仅看摄像头图像时，策略的无辅助成功率仍达 56.8%，超过两条基线。
